description: Connected Nations, previously called the Infrastructure Report, is Ofcom's annual report on the UK's communications infrastructure: fixed broadband coverage and take-up, mobile and wifi network coverage, digital television, digital radio and internet infrastructure, with interim updates during the year. Each edition is accompanied by data downloads; the national data portal entry, first listed in 2015, links the report pages and a fixed broadband dataset by postcode, and later editions add fixed coverage and performance by output area and local authority and mobile coverage by operator and technology for premises, geographic area and roads. Ofcom provides 'About this data' documents describing each file and applies its own terms of use. Coverage: the United Kingdom, by nation, local authority, output area and postcode. Format and access: ZIP archives of CSV files and PDF reports on the Ofcom website, free under Ofcom's terms. Caveats: Ofcom's site refused automated requests in this session, so the file list and reference dates of the latest edition were not checked; coverage is modelled from operator data, and definitions change between editions. Simulation uses: postcode-level exposure of premises to loss of fixed or mobile service, areas relying on a single operator or technology, and baselines for resilience planning. Related records: the Ofcom Sitefinder base stations and broadcast transmitter parameters describe sites, the Ofcom telecoms climate adaptation report covers risks, and the Ofcom home broadband performance data give measured speeds.
name: Ofcom Connected Nations: UK fixed broadband, mobile and wifi coverage data (formerly the Infrastructure Report)
notes: data.gov.uk entry read through the CKAN API on 2026-09-26 (description, resources, dates). ofcom.org.uk returned a Cloudflare challenge to curl and 403 to fetch. The output-area, local-authority and mobile breakdowns, interim updates and the 2011 start are from recall.
